author: Inside Edition
description: This high school senior is going off to college knowing everything. That's because Zoe Adkins of Nashville can proudly say that she's never missed a day of school. While other students might consider it unlucky, it was lucky for Zoe that she got sick over the Christmas break from school. But she tells WTVF that being present wasn't just about her desire to achieve great things. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: High School Senior Graduating With Perfect Attendance Since Kindergarten
